domain: Residential Rental Property Listings and Management
scenario:
A real estate management company is developing an enterprise-level platform to manage and facilitate residential rental property listings across various cities. The platform aims to streamline the process of advertising rental properties, managing tenant inquiries, and maintaining landlord-tenant relationships. The system will allow property owners and real estate agents to post listings with detailed information about each property, such as rent, size, location, and furnishing status.

Prospective tenants will be able to search for properties based on their preferences, such as budget, number of bedrooms, and desired locality. The platform will also manage tenant applications, schedule property viewings, and facilitate communication between tenants and landlords. Additionally, it should offer analytics to track market trends, rental prices, and tenant demographics.

The system will need a robust user management module to handle different roles, including property owners, real estate agents, tenants, and administrative staff. It should also support secure payment processing for rental transactions and feature a customer support system to handle inquiries and resolve disputes.
